Teinemine is predicted to target Phosphodiesterase 6C, which is a known target of Jbir-34. Jbir-34, in turn, is predicted to interact with the CD70 antigen. This pathway implies that Teinemine may exert its biological effects by modulating the activity of Phosphodiesterase 6C, which is involved in signaling pathways that ultimately influence the expression or function of CD70. The cumulative evidence supports a possible regulatory role of Teinemine in the CD70 antigen pathway, though the exact mechanism of interaction remains to be elucidated. The strength of the evidence is moderate, as it is based on predicted interactions rather than experimental validation. The relationship is supported by the integration of multiple layers of evidence, highlighting the complexity of the biological network involved.
